svg.title: The reduction of the chart forms to scalar lattice kernels is also explicit. An elementary stencil a is a finite signed sum of shifted edge readings, with coefficients at, offsets ut, a vector axis, and an ordered derivative list Da. Its Fourier polynomial factors as a sign, a translation character, and the product of the difference multipliers in Da. Thus, for two such stencils, X Y atbsχp(z + ut ± vs) = σa,b,±χp(z + ua,± + ub,±) qν(p). (PT24) t,s ν∈DaDb
